name: Starry Dreams
source:
In Starry Dreams, the player is a new resident of Sunflower Apartments, where they meet several interesting characters- two of which who want to open their own bakery! As the story progresses, the success of the bakery hinges on whether or not the player is good enough friends with the characters.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=37009]Lemmasoft thread[/url]]
translation:
在《Starry Dreams》中，玩家是Sunflower Apartments的新住户，会结识几位有趣的角色，其中两人正打算开一家面包店！随着故事推进，面包店能否成功，将取决于玩家与这些角色之间的友谊是否足够深厚。

[来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=37009]Lemma Soft论坛帖[/url]]
